title: Automatic Sequences: Theory, Applications, Generalizations
notes: Standard reference for q-automatic sequences and q-additive functions. A sequence is q-automatic iff its q-kernel is finite. Exact level sets {n : s(n)=0} of an unbounded q-additive function are the typical non-automatic example, as opposed to s(n) mod m. Used as the literature baseline for finite-state claims about s_bal(P(n))=0.
